fields.Name: T135 - New Category Slide-in Panel
fields.Description: Separate bespoke category-creation slide-in (distinct component from new-action panel), launched from the tree panel's new-category event.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the application switcher dropdown next to the logo, switch to the 'Actions' application, and open the 'Explorer' nav item. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away. In the LEFT category tree panel, find and click the 'new category' affordance (a plus '+' button in the tree panel header or next to a category node). Verify a 'New Category' slide-in panel opens with fields to define the category (name, and a parent selector). Seeing the new-category panel render with its input fields is success — you do NOT need to complete the create; you may close/cancel it.

judgeValidationCriteria: A '+' / new-category affordance is present in the Explorer's left tree panel
Clicking it opens a New Category slide-in panel with at least a name input field
The panel can be closed/cancelled and the Explorer remains functional
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
